phrase: a Portable Eye Screening Device Business
verdict: Yes, for a medical-device team. C3Med-Tech from Ahmedabad pitched smartphone-based portable eye devices on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Eye screening in rural areas is limited, and portable devices can help.
angle: Portable eye devices help eye camps and rural clinics screen patients. Hospitals and NGOs are buyers. CDSCO approval and clinical validation are required.
